classification: emotion-conditioned forward-return audit for selected factor sleeves; no portfolio promotion
forward_return: close-to-close, signal date to horizon date
implementation_note: Expanding monthly terciles; daily cross-sectional rank IC requires at least 30 finite observations per date; pass additionally requires NW p<=0.10, BH q<=0.10, at least 80 low/high daily observations, and a consistent high-minus-low sign.
known_limits: This is a conditional return audit, not a portfolio backtest.
Stock returns are cross-sectionally rank-scored and equal weighted within the eligible universe.
Emotion terciles are computed from expanding history only.
Current HS300 membership and current industry classification retain survivorship bias.
No leverage and no production activation.
